command.name: security key-manager external gcp enable
command.description: This command enables the Google Cloud Key Management Service (GCKMS) associated with the given Vserver. A GCP project and GCKMS must be deployed on the GCP portal prior to running this command. GCKMS can only be enabled on a data Vserver that doesn't already have a key manager configured. GCKMS cannot be enabled in a MetroCluster environment.

parameter.name: vserver
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the Vserver on which the GCKMS is to be enabled.

parameter.name: project-id
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the project ID of the deployed GCP project.

parameter.name: key-ring-name
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the key ring name of the deployed GCP project.

parameter.name: key-ring-location
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the location of the key ring.

parameter.name: key-name
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the key name of the GCKMS Key Encryption Key (KEK).

parameter.name: oauth-host
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the host name of the Open Authorization server.

parameter.name: oauth-url
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the URL of the Open Authorization access token.

parameter.name: privileged-account
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify a privileged service account (email address) with both cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToEncrypt and cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt permissions. If this parameter is specified, any calls made to the GCKMS will first use iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken to impersonate the privileged account.

parameter.name: port
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the port of the deployed Google Cloud KMS.

parameter.name: cloudkms-host
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the Google Cloud KMS Host's Subdomain.

parameter.name: verify
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify whether to verify the identity of Google Cloud KMS.

parameter.name: verify-host
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify whether to verify the identity of Google Cloud KMS hostname.

parameter.name: verify-ip
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify whether to verify the identity of Google Cloud KMS ip address.

parameter.name: proxy-type
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the proxy type.

parameter.name: proxy-host
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the proxy hostname.

parameter.name: proxy-port
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the proxy port.

parameter.name: proxy-username
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the proxy username.

parameter.name: proxy-password
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the proxy password.

parameter.name: timeout
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the Google Cloud connection timeout in seconds.

parameter.name: authentication-method
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the authentication method.

parameter.name: gce-metadata-server
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the custom Google Cloud Engine Metadata Server address used for authentication.

example.p: The following example enables the GCKMS for Vserver v1. The parameters in the example command identify a Google Cloud Platform (GCP) project application deployed on the GCP. The GCP project application has a Project ID "test_project", a key ring name "key_ring_for_test_project", a key ring location "secure_location_for_key_ring", a key name "testKEK" and OAuth server at 10.12.34.1.
example.screen:
cluster-1::*> security key-manager external gcp enable -vserver v1 -project-id test_project -key-ring-name key_ring_for_test_project -key-ring-location secure_location_for_key_ring -key-name testKEK -oauth-host 10.12.34.1
Enter the contents of the Google Cloud Key Management Service account key file (json file): Press <Enter> when done
